findings.title: Resource leak in report reader
findings.body: The new code opens a file on line 7 and appends the handle to `_open_reports` on line 8, but never closes it. The context manager (`with`) was removed, so the file remains open until program exit, leaking resources. Either restore the context manager or add explicit cleanup logic.
findings.suggestion:
with path.open(encoding="utf-8") as report:
        return report.read()

findings.title: Mutable global list in module scope
findings.body: The module-level list `_open_reports` is mutable and grows indefinitely as files are opened, creating a memory leak and potential instability. Either limit its size or manage it as a context-local resource.

summary.problem: The report reader leaks file handles and introduces a mutable global list, breaking resource safety and module isolation.
summary.done_well: The change preserves the function signature and return value.
